name: Cheluhi
overview: Cheluhi is a male descendant of Bani, noted specifically for having married a foreign wife. Beyond this unique attribute, Scripture does not provide further details about his tribal affiliation or additional personal notes. His mention is concise and focused on this particular aspect of his life.
namesAndTitles: The name Cheluhi appears only once in Scripture without an explicit meaning or divine origin indicated. It is presented plainly as a proper name without additional title or significance revealed in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Cheluhi is identified as a descendant of Bani, establishing a direct familial link. Scripture does not record any other family relationships for Cheluhi beyond this connection to Bani.
scriptureSignificance: Cheluhi's significance lies in his inclusion among those who had married foreign wives, a matter addressed during the post-exilic period as the community sought to maintain covenantal purity. His mention serves as a representative example of the challenges faced by the returning exiles in adhering to God's commands concerning marriage and community identity.
